home.legalTitle: How a US doctor can see you
home.legalBody: Your doctor is licensed in the United States and consults you from there by video. The visit is a first consultation and a second opinion: the doctor explains your condition, reviews your records and recommends next steps. It is not an emergency service and does not replace your local physician.
home.faq1Q: Do I need to travel to the US?
home.faq1A: No. You join the visit from home in your country, by video or phone.
home.faq2Q: What does US board certified mean?
home.faq2A: The doctor passed a national specialty exam after residency, on top of the licence every doctor needs. We check both.
home.faq3Q: How much does a first visit cost?
home.faq3A: Each doctor sets one price, shown on the profile before you book. There is nothing to pay until you book.

faq.metaDescription: Plain answers about first visits with US-trained doctors, fees and refunds, how your records are handled, and joining as a doctor.
faq.title: Common questions
faq.lead: Short, plain answers about visits, fees, your records and joining as a doctor.
faq.resultCount: {count, plural, one {{countLabel} question matches} other {{countLabel} questions match}}

travel.q: Do I need to travel to the US?
travel.a: No. You join the visit from home in your country, by video or phone.

usDoctor.q: How can a US doctor see me?
usDoctor.a: Your doctor is licensed in the US and sees you from there by video or phone. The visit is a second opinion: the doctor explains your condition, reviews your records and suggests next steps.

cannotDo.q: What can this visit not do?
cannotDo.a: It is not for emergencies. If this is urgent, call {number}. Over video or phone the doctor cannot examine you. Your local doctor stays in charge of tests, prescriptions and follow-up.

boardCertified.q: What does US board certified mean?
boardCertified.a: The doctor passed a national specialty exam after residency, on top of the licence every doctor needs. We check both.

account.a: Not to browse. You can search for doctors and read their profiles without one. You sign in with your email only when you book or upload records.

visitTime.q: Is the visit time shown in my time or the doctor's?
visitTime.a: Every time is shown in your own time zone, with the zone named, like {example}. Your booking confirmation shows both times.

dialect.q: Will the doctor speak my dialect?
dialect.a: Every doctor on 3affya speaks Arabic. Each profile lists the doctor's languages and dialect, so you can choose someone who speaks the way you do.

cost.q: How much does a first visit cost?
cost.a: Each doctor sets one price, shown on the profile before you book. There is nothing to pay until you book.

included.q: What is included in the price?
included.a: The price you see covers everything: the doctor's fee, the 3affya fee and card processing. At checkout these show as three lines that add up to the same total. Nothing is added later.

pay.a: By card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, when you book. We hold your time for {minutes, plural, one {{minutesLabel} minute} other {{minutesLabel} minutes}} while you pay. You pay 3affya once, for the first visit.

cancel.q: Can I cancel and get a refund?
cancel.a: Yes. The cancellation terms are shown on the payment step, before you pay. If the doctor cancels, you get a full refund. Refunds go back to the card or wallet you paid with.

afterVisit.q: Do I pay anything after the first visit?
afterVisit.a: Not to 3affya. If you keep seeing the same doctor after the first visit, you agree on that care and its cost with the doctor directly.

processing.q: What happens to the records I upload?
processing.a: AI reads each page and writes a one-page summary and a dated timeline for your doctor. Every item links to the page it came from. Missing or unreadable pages are flagged, never guessed.

aiConsent.q: Do you ask before AI reads my records?
aiConsent.a: Yes. Consent to AI processing is its own checkbox, separate from the privacy consent. No file is processed until you agree and pay.

storage.a: On a private, encrypted server run for 3affya. Only you and the doctor you choose can open them. Before you agree, the upload page says where your files are stored and processed.

recordsCost.q: How much does a records summary cost?
recordsCost.a: {price} for every {gb} GB of files, rounded up to the next {gb} GB. You see the price before you pay. If processing fails, trying again is free.

notDiagnosis.q: Is the AI summary a diagnosis?
notDiagnosis.a: No. The summary is labelled as written by AI, and it helps your doctor prepare. It does not diagnose and does not replace the visit. Your doctor decides what it means.

sharing.a: Only you, until you share it with a doctor you choose. A share link stops working after {days, plural, one {{daysLabel} day} other {{daysLabel} days}}, or sooner if you turn it off.

deleting.a: Yes, at any time from your account. Deleting removes your files, the summary and any share links. We keep only a note that the deletion happened.

whoCanJoin.a: Doctors with a US licence who speak Arabic. Many already have a profile here, built from public US records and marked as unclaimed.

claim.q: How do I claim my profile?
claim.a: Open your invite link, or find your profile and tap “{claim}”. Claiming is free. Add your credentials, fee and times, then we review and publish it.

verification.a: Before a profile goes live, we check the US state licence and board certification against the official registries. The verified badge shows the date, and we check again every {months, plural, one {month} other {{monthsLabel} months}}.

removal.q: Can I have my listing removed?
removal.a: Yes. Open your profile and ask for it to be removed. We confirm it is you, then take the page down within {hours, plural, one {{hoursLabel} hour} other {{hoursLabel} hours}}.

payouts.a: You set your own first-visit fee. Patients pay through 3affya, and Stripe pays you out to your bank. After the first visit, care and payment continue directly between you and the patient.

faq.emptyBody: Try one short word, like fee or records. Or send us your question and a person on our team will answer.
